                                             Section 8
Section 8 ia a team of players who love to have fun and roleplay with eachother. Everytime one of us or another member is in trouble, we all band togehter to save/help the person. Same with everyone else. Section 8 saves people from danger or getting in danger. We dont decline anyones request for help unless its stupid or just plain wrong. That means we don't back down from anything.
